name: budget
definition: The run's budget-deployment target and clock. Read by scripts/gate_artifact.sh (REQUIRE_SHIP_AUTHORIZATION=1) as a light under-spend backstop, and the reference for the felt-budget heuristic (AGENTS.md § Resources; HEARTBEAT.md burn-rate). The budget is a target to DEPLOY on depth, not just a ceiling to stay under.
change_policy: Tier-2 memo. api_budget/cloud_budget come from BRIEF.md; deadline_iso/launch_iso are set hour-0 from the actual launch time. The under-spend floors (>50% time AND >40% budget remaining at a ship-candidate state = under-spend, not a finish) mirror the HEARTBEAT.md under-spend signal.
